motivation: The original same-census mechanical-coupling simulation destroyed latent N_eff alignment with a year-block permutation that did not preserve serial structure. Repeat the identical fixed count-error models using island-wise circular shifts of latent colony composition so the topology null retains each island's temporal ordering, cyclic autocorrelation and trend shape.

construction: For each replicate and island, draw one circular lag uniformly from 0,...,n_i-1 over the eligible positive-current transition years.
Reject only the global identity lag vector.
For each target current island-year, retain its observed total abundance but replace its latent colony-share vector with the same island's circularly shifted donor-year share vector.
Do not permute totals, response years, island identity or secular time.
For terminal next-year states that are not eligible current transitions, use their observed colony-share vector for count simulation.
preservation: island-specific cyclic temporal ordering and circular autocovariance
observed total-abundance trajectory and calendar years
latent_topology_null.broken_relation: calendar alignment between latent colony composition/N_eff and future growth

paired_coupling_design.coupled: derive N_eff_t and current_total_t from the same simulated colony-count vector A
paired_coupling_design.decoupled: derive N_eff_t from A but current_total_t from independent vector B
paired_coupling_design.next_total: use the same independent B state series for next-year totals in both coupled and decoupled fits, preserving census-to-census continuity
paired_coupling_design.target_quantity: beta_coupled - beta_decoupled isolates coefficient shift due to sharing current-year count error between N_eff and the growth denominator/baseline abundance

model: same frozen full-data C1 coefficient model: next_growth ~ island fixed effects + z(log1p current abundance) + z(year) + z(log1p N_eff)
primary_outputs: coupled beta null distribution and one-sided probability beta >= observed
decoupled beta null distribution and one-sided probability beta >= observed
median and mean paired coupling bias as fractions of observed beta

interpretation_rules.association_survives_circular_coupling: observed beta remains unusual (one-sided p <= 0.05) under all three coupled circular-shift count-error nulls
interpretation_rules.association_fails_circular_coupling: any coupled circular-shift error model has p > 0.05
interpretation_rules.manuscript_if_survives: Retain N_eff only as a conditional association that survives serial-structure-preserving coefficient and fixed shared-count-error diagnostics; predictive claim remains withdrawn.
interpretation_rules.manuscript_if_fails: Downgrade N_eff to descriptive only despite the coefficient-only circular-shift result.

boundaries: This replaces the latent topology null of the original mechanical-coupling diagnostic; it does not add an error-model family.
Poisson and fixed 10%/20% Gamma-Poisson models remain stylized sensitivities, not calibrated observer-error models.
No additional CV values, noise families, lag restrictions or topology metrics may be added after execution.
Held-out predictive gain remains unsupported regardless of this result.
freeze_note: This contract was frozen before the circular-shift outcome receipt existed; the Poisson and 10%/20% Gamma-Poisson families are inherited unchanged from the earlier mechanical-coupling diagnostic.
